summary.en: Post-punk tightness with pop hooks, chorus guitar, and early synth color.
summary.zh: 后朋克的紧凑 + 流行钩子、chorus 吉他与早期合成器色彩。

body.en:
New Wave keeps punk’s short forms and adds danceable grids, cleaner production, and MTV-ready image. Bass and rhythm guitar often lead; solos shrink.

Talking Heads, The Police, and early Cure sit on the chronicle’s post-punk → pop/alternative bridge.
body.zh:
New Wave 保留朋克短曲式，加上可跳舞的格子、更干净的制作与适合 MTV 的形象。贝斯与节奏吉他常主导；Solo 缩小。

Talking Heads、The Police 与早期 Cure 坐在本站后朋 → 流行/alternative 的桥上。
